# sorts
sort Job = struct job(jn: Node, jp: Nat);  % record
sort Node = struct node(ix: Nat);  % record
sort St = struct IDLE | BUSY | DONE;  % enumeration
sort Why = struct wnone | wfail(wn: Node);  % union
# maps
map anyBusy: List(Node) # (Node -> St) -> Bool;
map bump: (Node -> Nat) # List(Node) -> Node -> Nat;
map cap: Nat # Nat -> Nat;
map gen_init_slots: Nat -> Nat;
map isFail: Why -> Bool;
map lim: Nat;
map next: St -> St;
map tick: (St -> Nat) # St -> St -> Nat;
# equations
anyBusy((n |> l), g) = ((g(n) == BUSY) || anyBusy(l, g));
anyBusy([], g) = false;
bump(f, (n |> l)) = bump(f[n -> Pos2Nat((f(n) + 1))], l);
bump(f, []) = f;
cap(a, b) = if((a > b), b, a);
gen_init_slots(w) = (2 * w);
isFail(wfail(n)) = true;
isFail(wnone) = false;
lim = 3;
next(BUSY) = DONE;
next(DONE) = DONE;
next(IDLE) = BUSY;
tick(t, s) = t[s -> Pos2Nat((t(s) + 1))];
# actions
act c_done: Node;
act c_finish: Nat;
act c_fire: Node # Nat;
act c_halt: Why;
act c_start: Job;
act c_submit: Node # List(Node);
# parameters
w: Nat = 2
n: Nat = 0
st: Node -> St = (lambda x: Node . IDLE)
deps: Node -> List(Node) = (lambda x: Node . [])
RQ: FSet(Node) = {}
run: Nat = 0
why: Why = wnone
uses: Node -> Nat = (lambda x: Node . 0)
tally: St -> Nat = (lambda s: St . 0)
slots: Nat = (2 * 2)
# summands (9, delta summands 1)
summand c_submit
  sum x: Node, l: List(Node)
  cond ((ix(x) == n) && ((st(x) == IDLE) && !anyBusy(l, st)))
  act  c_submit(x, l)
  n := (n + 1)
  deps := deps[x -> l]
  RQ := (RQ + ({x} + {}))
  uses := bump(uses, l)
summand c_fire
  sum x: Node, d: List(Node)
  cond ((d == deps(x)) && ((x in RQ) && ((run < cap(w, lim)) && (forall y: Node . ((y in deps(x)) => (st(y) == DONE))))))
  act  c_fire(x, #d)
  st := st[x -> next(st(x))]
  RQ := (RQ - ({x} + {}))
  run := (run + 1)
summand c_fire#2
  sum x: Node
  cond ((x in RQ) && ((run == 0) && (deps(x) == [])))
  act  c_fire(x, 0)
  st := st[x -> next(st(x))]
  RQ := (RQ - ({x} + {}))
  run := 1
summand c_done
  sum x: Node
  cond ((st(x) == BUSY) && (run > 0))
  act  c_done(x)
  st := st[x -> next(st(x))]
  run := Int2Nat((run - 1))
summand c_finish
  cond ((n > 0) && ((run == 0) && ((RQ == {}) && !isFail(why))))
  act  c_finish(n)
  n := 0
summand c_finish#2
  cond ((n > 0) && ((run == 0) && ((RQ == {}) && isFail(why))))
  act  c_finish(0)
  n := 0
summand c_finish#3
  cond ((n == 0) && (run > lim))
  act  c_finish(1)
  why := wnone
summand c_start
  sum x: Node
  cond ((x in RQ) && (slots > 0))
  act  c_start(job(x, uses(x)))
  tally := tick(tally, BUSY)
  slots := Int2Nat((slots - 1))
summand c_halt
  sum y: Why
  cond (run == 0)
  act  c_halt(y)
  why := y
# accepted
